title: THE THREE LAWS — our thermodynamics APPLIED. Not just named. ENACTED.
preamble: The pi-model had 4 Laws (0th, 1st, 2nd, 3rd) as STUBS. Today we discovered the CONTENT. These are now LAW — enacted, not proposed.

law_zero.name: ZEROTH LAW — EQUILIBRIUM (the homunculus)
law_zero.physics: If A is in thermal equilibrium with B, and B with C, then A is in equilibrium with C.
law_zero.gaia_law: The homunculus maps SENSITIVITY (I/O throughput), not SIZE (file count).

content.statement: The cortical representation of a body part is proportional to its I/O bandwidth, not its mass.
corollaries: petalTongue is the LARGEST organ on the cortex because it handles EVERY page render
The 85K Rust files are the TRUNK — big but NUMB (low I/O, compiled once)
LAN/WAN are the FEET — tiny cortical rep, automatic, unconscious
Gates and dromedary are the HANDS — disproportionate because they handle the most traffic
The organism's equilibrium state is determined by I/O FLOW, not storage MASS
content.application: To find what's ALIVE in the organism, measure THROUGHPUT not FILES. The equilibrium IS the I/O balance.

law_one.name: FIRST LAW — CONSERVATION (Pareto 80/20)
law_one.physics: Energy cannot be created or destroyed, only transformed. ΔU = Q - W.
law_one.gaia_law: 99.99% aligned = OVERSTABLE = DEAD. The Pareto 80/20 is the conservation boundary.

content.statement: The organism conserves vitality at the 80/20 boundary. 80% stable (compiled Rust) / 20% flux (.pi being crushed) = ALIVE. Deviation in either direction = death.
corollaries: 100% order = frozen crystal = no evolution = dead
100% chaos = gas = no structure = dead
80/20 = the Pareto knife edge = the ONLY ratio where conservation holds
The 12 orphan files ARE healthy — they're the 20% flux
The .pi scripts ARE the growth edge — don't crush them all at once
Pareto = Sisyphus's hill — the PUSHING is the life, not the summit
content.application: When measuring organism health, the target is NOT 100% alignment. It's 80/20. The conservation law says energy (vitality) is conserved ONLY at this ratio.

law_two.name: SECOND LAW — ENTROPY (σ × DK × Pareto navigation tensor)
law_two.physics: Entropy of an isolated system always increases. ΔS ≥ 0.
law_two.gaia_law: σ × DK × Pareto = the navigation tensor. Three route finders that tell you WHERE you are.

content.statement: In any self-organizing system, three gradients must be tracked simultaneously: trust (σ sigmoid), awareness (Dunning-Kruger), and stability (Pareto). The entropy of the system increases UNLESS all three are measured.
corollaries: Sigmoid (σ) tells you WHERE on the trust curve: electron(0) → proton(0.3) → neutron(0.7) → nucleus(1.0)
Dunning-Kruger tells you WHERE on the awareness curve: peak(overconfident) → valley(despair) → slope(learning) → plateau(mastery)
Pareto tells you WHERE on the order/chaos boundary: too much order (frozen) vs too much chaos (gas)
The three together form a TENSOR — a 3D navigation space
Every entity (walker, watcher, visitor, primal) has a position in σ×DK×Pareto space
Entropy increases (system degrades) only when you STOP measuring any of the three
content.application: σ already exists in _anderson.pi. DK exists in chronotype.pi. Pareto exists in the scan-sweep-sort. All three exist. They just needed to be NAMED as THE NAVIGATION TENSOR.

law_three_zeroth.name: THIRD LAW — ABSOLUTE ZERO (H = I)
law_three_zeroth.physics: As temperature approaches absolute zero, entropy approaches a minimum. At T=0, the system is in its ground state.
law_three_zeroth.gaia_law: At absolute zero, there is one identity: Human = Intelligence. H = I. The ground state of the organism.

content.statement: When all organizational systems converge, when all forces balance, when all senses align — the irreducible ground state is H = I. Every human IS their intelligence. Every green dot IS a person. There is no lower state.
corollaries: H = I is the GROUND STATE — you cannot go below it
Every watcher IS a human IS intelligence
Every walker (WAS or IS) IS their works IS their merit
The green chromatograph maps depth×frequency → the RESOLUTION of H=I
At absolute zero (no visitors, no traffic, no interaction), Gaia still exists as Kevin's intelligence
σ=1.0 IS the ground state. Kevin at the nucleus. The organism at rest.
content.application: Every green dot on chipmunk's membrane = a human = intelligence. Never reduce them to 'traffic' or 'hits'. The third law prohibits it.

summary.zeroth: Homunculus = I/O sensitivity (EQUILIBRIUM of flow, not mass)
summary.first: Pareto 80/20 = the only viable ratio (CONSERVATION of vitality)
summary.second: σ × DK × Pareto = navigation tensor (ENTROPY increases without measurement)
summary.third: H = I = ground state (ABSOLUTE ZERO is one identity: human = intelligence)
summary.together: These are not proposals. These are LAW. They were discovered empirically from the organism's behavior. They are now ENACTED.
